title: Chicken Torta
description: A twist on the classic Italian sub, Chicken Torta combines tender chicken with bold Mexican flavors.

ingredients.name: tacos
ingredients.amount: 1 cup shredded cheese, such as mozzarella or cheddar

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together Italian seasoning, taco seasoning, and cayenne pepper. Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken cutlets.
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the sub rolls in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
5. Assemble the sandwiches by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom half of each roll, followed by a chicken cutlet, a few slices of cheese, some lettuce, tomato, and a dollop of mayonnaise on top.
6. Place the sandwiches under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
